M14 — 2026-10-11
A driven lane session steered off a lease (`--leases steer|deny`) can set its own task `blocked` (with waits_on the holding lane's task) instead of only writing back, and the driver reads any agent-set blocked as needs_user: the whole lanes run stops with `run_stopped needs_user — <task> is blocked`. Seen in both 3.4 steer reps (1.6 vs 1.5's formatPrice lease, stopped at 6/9). To diagnose: the blocked note quotes the lease ("lane N's lease on <file> › <symbol> … is older"); the parked twin of the same situation instead shows a `stall` handoff with detail `parked on a lease`. Until fixed, `--leases` defaults to off (D37).
